teaching_move: Use minimal tone pairs and require tone marks in written rehearsal.
Teach object-specific classifier chunks such as 一杯茶, 两本书, 三张票.
Contrast 找票 and 找到票了; ask whether the action reached a result.
Practice subject + time/place + verb phrase frames before open production.
Use short action-result routines and compare verb-final 了 with sentence-final 了.
